display-hero.purpose: Signed-out home headline only; 2.5rem, 3rem from sm, 3.75rem from lg.

display-decision.purpose: Day and time in the ink decision panel; 1.875rem from sm.

headline-group.purpose: Group or plan name at the top of the group view; 2.25rem from sm.

title-section.purpose: Section headings such as Próximas 4 semanas and Mejores días.

title-row.purpose: Option days, plan names and group names in lists.

label.purpose: Field labels, chip names, cloth captions.

caption.purpose: Axis ticks, legend, avatar initials, tags.

shadows.name: thread-lift
shadows.purpose: The only lift in the system: spun yarn lying on the weave (CSS filter on .yarn). Labelled yarn drops it.

patterns.name: yarn
patterns.purpose: Spun twist over a thread colour: free time riding on top.

patterns.name: thread-dive
patterns.purpose: Solid busy under-thread; solid on purpose so it never reads as the dotted unknown thread.

patterns.name: thread-loose
patterns.purpose: Loose dotted thread: no schedule. Never reads as free.

patterns.name: cloth-closed
patterns.value: rgb(35 38 58 / 0.08) with 90deg and 0deg repeating 1px ink lines every 5px (0.16 and 0.12 alpha)
patterns.purpose: Warp-and-weft fill behind the band when every member fits.

patterns.name: hatch-busy
patterns.purpose: Busy blocks in the profile schedule editor.

focus.purpose: Global focus-visible ring; woven bands take it from their row's hidden radio.

motion.name: weave-move
motion.purpose: Thread segments and the band re-weave when the selected option changes; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

layout.shellWide: full width, 16px gutter; sm 42rem / 24px; md 48rem; lg 72rem / 32px
layout.stickyFooter: ground fill, hairline top border, safe-area bottom padding; html:has(.sticky-footer) reserves scroll-padding-bottom of footer height + 12px

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single madder-red action per screen; full width, in the sticky footer on phones.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 3.125rem; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-madder, #b8322a); color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.0625rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-madder-pressed, #9c2a23); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-madder-active, #85231d); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-rule, #d3d6d0); color: var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-indigo, #2f4fa2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bleached cloth with a 1.5px ink border; pairs share a row (Invitar / Compartir).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #23263a); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-panel, #f1f2ef); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--color-rule, #d3d6d0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-indigo, #2f4fa2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface field with cloth corners and a bold label above; focus is the global indigo ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f7284); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); font: inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-indigo, #2f4fa2); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: One row: indigo back link with chevron, optional ink aside; no app chrome.
components.html: Grupos
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-back { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; margin-left: -8px; color: var(--color-indigo, #2f4fa2); text-decoration: none; } .ds-back:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-indigo, #2f4fa2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Member Chip
components.description: Knot-cornered name chip led by a spun-yarn swatch in the member's thread colour; dotted on panel when they have no schedule.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f7284); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-chip-unknown { border-style: dotted; background: var(--color-panel, #f1f2ef); color: var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); } .ds-swatch { width: 16px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-55deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.36) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.5px 4px); }

components.name: Decision Panel
components.description: The ink slab naming the closed band: the day and time in Bricolage, who can and who is missing below.
components.html:
Sáb 5 dic · 19:00

Pueden 10 de 12 · faltan los horarios de Caro, Isi
components.css: .ds-decision { padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-ink, #23263a); color: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-decision h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Figtree, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.625rem; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-decision p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink-sub, #c9ccd8); }

components.name: Day Cloth
components.description: Signature: one thread per member across the day; free rides on top as spun yarn, busy dives to a solid under-thread between coloured ticks, unknown hangs loose and dotted; the band is outlined in ink and fills with warp and weft when everyone fits.
components.css: .ds-cloth { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cloth figcaption { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-cloth-body { position: relative; padding: 28px 0 4px; } .ds-band { position: absolute; top: 20px; bottom: -2px; left: calc(32px + 62%); width: 22%; border: 2px dashed var(--color-ink, #23263a); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-band-label { position: absolute; top: -20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink, #23263a); color: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.125rem; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; } .ds-row b { width: 32px; flex: none; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-track { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 100%; } .ds-track::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-rule, #d3d6d0); } .ds-free { position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 8px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 9999px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-55deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.36) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.5px 4px); } .ds-dive { position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 3px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: var(--color-rule-strong, #6f7284); } .ds-tick { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 2.5px; height: 10px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-loose { position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-mute, #4a4d60) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); } .ds-cloth-sum { margin: 6px 0 0 32px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-cloth-legend { margin: 2px 0 0 32px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); }

components.name: Woven Band
components.description: Signature miniature of the cloth beside each option and in each strip day; frame weight carries rank.
components.css: .ds-wband { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; width: 40px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #6f7284); background: var(--color-panel, #f1f2ef); } .ds-wband-best { border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink, #23263a); background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); } .ds-wband:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); } .ds-wrow { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 6px; } .ds-wfree { display: block; width: 100%; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-55deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.36) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.5px 4px); } .ds-wloose { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-mute, #4a4d60) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); } .ds-wdive { flex: 1; height: 2px; background: var(--color-rule-strong, #6f7284); } .ds-wtick { flex: none; width: 2px; height: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Avatars
components.description: 24px initials: filled when free, bordered with an ink strike when busy, dashed mute when unknown.
components.css: .ds-av { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-right: 3px; overflow: hidden; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.75rem; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-av-busy { background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--color-ink, #23263a); } .ds-av-busy::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; top: 50%; height: 1.5px; background: var(--color-ink, #23263a); transform: rotate(-45deg); } .ds-av-unknown { border: 1.5px dashed var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); background: var(--color-surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--color-mute, #4a4d60); }

narrative.overview:
The app is a loom. Each person in a group is one dyed-wool thread running across the hours of a day. Where a person is free their thread rides on top of the cloth in their colour, spun so its twist shows; where they are busy the thread dives under the cloth and only a thin grey under-thread runs between two coloured ticks; where nobody knows their schedule the thread hangs loose and dotted. Where every thread rides on top at once, the cloth closes into a band, and that band is the day the group meets. The whole interface exists to make that band visible and to propose it in one tap.

The material is real: every free thread is drawn with a twisted-wool texture (raster strips generated in `scripts/yarn/` from the brand's yarn generator), and every surface is a woven tile, never a flat fill. The ground is undyed grey wool, the ink is indigo-black, and the only saturated colour that is not a person is madder red, reserved for the one action that ends the screen. Surfaces are folded cloth with soft 14px blanket-edge corners and no box-shadows; the single lift in the system is the soft shadow a thread casts on the weave beneath it. Density is phone-first and generous at the target level (44px minimum) but tight in the woven diagrams, which grow denser, never taller, as groups grow. The app is light only on purpose: it is read on phones outdoors, in daylight.

The world refuses the scheduling category's green heatmap grid and the replaced "Línea de Metro" signage. The weave is one form at every scale: the full day cloth, the small woven band beside each option, the day strip, the member chips, the plan marks, the app icon and the link preview all draw the same thread language.
keyCharacteristics: One thread per person, in the colour they picked (or a free one by join order); colour says *who*, shape says *state*.
Real yarn on woven cloth: textured threads, woven grounds, cards and panels; states are translucent ink washes over the weave.
Free = spun thread on top; busy = solid grey under-thread with coloured dive ticks; unknown = loose dotted thread. Unknown never reads as free.
The closed band (an ink-outlined window with a faint warp-and-weft fill) is the decision.
Madder red is the single primary action per screen and is never a person's colour.
Woven surfaces, 14px and 6px corners, no box-shadows, light ground only.
Bricolage Grotesque for names and big numbers; Figtree for everything you operate.

rules.name: The Colour Says Who Rule
rules.body: A thread colour identifies a person and nothing else. Free, busy and unknown are carried by shape (spun on top, dived under, loose dotted), so the cloth reads the same in greyscale.

rules.name: The Madder Is Not A Person Rule
rules.body: Madder red is reserved for the primary action and is never given to a thread. If a screen has two madder elements, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Measured On The Weave Rule
rules.body: Text contrast is measured against the textured tiles at text scale (the 2nd and 98th percentile fibres), not the flat hex. Ink stays above 10.8:1 and mute above 6:1 on every light weave; white on the dark wool stays above 7.6:1.

rules.name: The First To Join Keeps It Rule
rules.body: A member who joins later never changes anyone else's thread. Clashes resolve in join order, and only the person whose colour moved is told, in one line.

rules.name: The Double-Ply Rule
rules.body: When a group outgrows the eight colours, second-cycle members (`threadPly(index) === 2`) draw every thread, swatch and avatar border double-ply, so no member relies on colour alone.

rules.name: The Names Are Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for group names, the decided day and the hero; anything you tap or read in a list is Figtree.

rules.name: The Flat Cloth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows; only threads do. To raise importance, thicken the ink border (1px rule, 1.5px ink, 2.5–3px ink) or invert to the ink panel.

rules.name: The Opaque Weave Rule
rules.body: The tiles are opaque, so a state is a translucent wash layered over the weave (`--cloth-wash`), never a flat colour that would either vanish under the tile or cover it with a flat patch. For the same reason, an inline style on a `.yarn` element sets `backgroundColor`, never the `background` shorthand, which resets the texture to none.

dos: Do give every person exactly one thread colour per group: their pick when it is free, otherwise the next free colour by join order; switch second-cycle members to double-ply.
Do draw threads and surfaces with the yarn and cloth textures; pass thread colours inline as `backgroundColor`.
Do express hover, pressed and panel states as translucent ink washes over the weave.
Do carry free, busy and unknown by shape: spun yarn on top, solid under-thread with dive ticks, loose dotted thread.
Do use madder red (#b8322a) for the one primary action per screen, in the sticky footer on phones.
Do use cloth corners (14px) for surfaces and controls and knot corners (6px) for chips, tags and woven bands.
Do raise emphasis with ink border weight or the ink panel, never with shadow.
Do keep every target at least 44px and reserve scroll padding under sticky footers.
Do let big groups make the cloth denser, never collapse members into an aggregate.
donts: Don't give madder red to a person's thread, or use thread colours for text, buttons or panels.
Don't draw unknown time as anything that could read as free; never solid, never coloured.
Don't draw the busy under-thread dotted or dashed; at 2–3px it would read as the "no schedule" thread.
Don't add box-shadows, elevation or a dark theme; the ground is daylight grey wool, and only threads cast a shadow.
Don't put white text on plain yarn; use the labelled yarn wash.
Don't let a newcomer's pick change the colour of someone already in the group.
Don't build availability as a green heatmap grid or as transit-line signage.
Don't cap a screen at phone width on desktop.
